content_sections.heading: IIT Guwahati Assistant Project Engineer Recruitment 2026 Overview
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the age limit or the application fee.

rows.information: Online, through the R&D Recruitment Portal

content_sections.heading: About IIT Guwahati
content_sections.text: The Indian Institute of Technology Guwahati is in Guwahati, Assam. Its Research and Development Section issued this notice. The post sits in the Department of Civil Engineering under the project "Safe Guwahati: AI-Based Driver and Road Monitoring System for Safer Public Transport". The project is led by Principal Investigator Prof. Akhilesh Kumar Maurya.

content_sections.heading: IIT Guwahati Assistant Project Engineer Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Essential qualification: B.E./B.Tech./M.E./M.Tech. in Civil Engineering. Preferred: M.Tech in Transportation Engineering, and an understanding of Machine Learning. Check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection depends on the candidate's performance in the offline interview. Everyone who applies must attend the interview on 3 November 2026 at 11:00 AM in the Meeting room, Department of Civil Engineering, IIT Guwahati. No TA/DA is paid for appearing in the test and interview.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The appointment is for 5 months and can be extended up to 11 months. The post is attached to the "Safe Guwahati" project in the Department of Civil Engineering. No campus accommodation will be provided to the selected candidate.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Guwahati Assistant Project Engineer Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Open the Recruitment Portal of the Research & Development Cell, IIT Guwahati: https://iitg.ac.in/rndproj/recruitment/ . Search for the project title "Safe Guwahati: AI-Based Driver and Road Monitoring System for Safer Public Transport" to find the position. Fill in the application according to the instructions and guidelines on the portal. Submit it by 5:00 pm on 2 November 2026. Attend the offline interview on 3 November 2026 at 11:00 AM. For technical help with the online form, email [email protected] . For questions about the post, contact Prof. Akhilesh Kumar Maurya at [email protected] .

faq.question: Q1. How many Assistant Project Engineer posts are vacant?
faq.answer: There is 1 (One) vacancy, in the Department of Civil Engineering project "Safe Guwahati".

faq.question: Q2. What is the monthly salary?
faq.answer: The pay is Rs. 28,500, plus HRA of Rs. 5,700 and a medical allowance of Rs. 1,250, for a total of Rs. 35,450 a month.

faq.question: Q3. Which degrees are accepted?
faq.answer: The essential qualification is B.E./B.Tech./M.E./M.Tech. in Civil Engineering.

faq.question: Q4. Who gets preference?
faq.answer: Candidates with an M.Tech in Transportation Engineering and an understanding of Machine Learning get preference.

faq.question: Q5. When and where is the interview?
faq.answer: The offline interview is on 3 November 2026 (Tuesday) at 11:00 AM in the Meeting room, Department of Civil Engineering, IIT Guwahati.

faq.question: Q6. How long is the appointment?
faq.answer: It runs for 5 months and can be extended up to 11 months.

faq.question: Q7. How do I find the post on the portal?
faq.answer: Search for the project title on the R&D Recruitment Portal (https://iitg.ac.in/rndproj/recruitment/).

faq.question: Q8. Is accommodation or travel allowance provided?
faq.answer: No. Selected candidates get no campus accommodation, and no TA/DA is paid for attending the test and interview.
